snippet.description:
VERTIQ – HIGH-PERFORMANCE PROPELLER ACTUATORS AND MOTORS FOR NEXT-GEN UAV CONTROL

Vertiq develops advanced propulsion modules that integrate a brushless motor, ESC and onboard control firmware into a single high-precision actuator.
With ultra-fast response, real-time health monitoring and tight position control, Vertiq actuators enable smoother flight dynamics, improved stability and more efficient performance across multirotor, VTOL and hybrid UAV platforms.

For the latest in autonomous technologies & robotics, follow Unmanned Systems Technology (UST)

snippet.title: Someone tossed this HYTE Y60 gaming #pc in the TRASH! #shorts #tech #technology
snippet.description: This used to be a CyberPower PC, but now it’s just a HYTE Y60 with a Raptor Lake ASROCK motherboard. A company gave it to our partner Trident Electronics Recycling, and I got my hands on it because I was curious what was wrong with it and why someone would toss it. All I know is it had an i9-13900K installed which Trident removed before giving it to me. I installed the 13700K I had in my test bench, and it booted right up! The BIOS wasn’t updated, so the only theory I have is the i9 was crashing due to the Raptor Lake instability issue, so they tossed it! Anyways, say hello to my new PC, as soon as DDR5 prices drop… #pc #tech #technology #computer

All I know is it had an i9-13900K installed which Trident removed before giving it to me. I installed the 13700K I had in my test bench, and it booted right up! The BIOS wasn’t updated, so the only theory I have is the i9 was crashing due to the Raptor Lake instability issue, so they tossed it! Anyways, say hello to my new PC, as soon as DDR5 prices drop… #pc #tech #technology #computer

‏Introducing the "VitalWear SmartBand," a next-generation wearable gadget that combines health monitoring, productivity tools, and entertainment features in a sleek, minimalist design. It features a flexible OLED display that wraps around the wrist, providing a comfortable fit and immersive visual experience. The SmartBand tracks vital signs Like heart rate, blood oxygen Levels, and body temperature in real-time, using advanced sensors and Al algorithms to provide personalized health insights and alerts.
